decision.observation: The farmer is awake at 7:00 a.m. on Saturday with full energy; the farmhouse exit is at the bottom-left.
decision.hypothesis: Moving down-left to the exit will start the trip early enough to reach Willy during shop hours.
decision.memory: Willy promised an item at the southeast beach. From the farm, use the mailbox-level path east. West of town, take the southeast branch through the fountain square to the southern east–west road, then go east across the river before turning south; do not take town's south exit into the wooded river area.
